display.methodZh: 本轮通过 Kimi Coding Plan 原生 Anthropic Messages 协议调用 k3.1-pro，地址 https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/messages。每组计划 23 题，default / low / max 三组请求参数最多并发 3 个请求；每组内逐题执行。5 小时订阅额度耗尽后停止新请求，未派发任务不伪造记录，额度错误不计为模型答题失败。默认 effort 的文档值为 max；这两组保留独立请求，不当作两个不同能力档位。low / max 使用原生 output_config.effort；不把 thinking 预算当成 effort。输入 token 合计为原生 input_tokens、cache_read_input_tokens 与 cache_creation_input_tokens 之和，原 usage 字段完整保留。初轮 max_tokens=12,288，包含思考和正文；超时 600 秒，temperature / top_p 省略，没有独立设置 thinking.budget_tokens。按订阅额度消耗，不能按官方按量标价换算成实际账单。此前停止的 Chat Completions 子集单独保留。静态与动图源自模型原始 SVG，未修复源码；点评是 AI 助手的定性视觉检查。单次耗时受服务端排队、三个请求的并发和输出长度影响，不能据此建立稳定速度排名。逐次保留请求与返回模型 ID；可变 API 路由不构成内部固定 checkpoint 的独立证明。服务端接受了非法 effort 负向探针，因此无法独立确认 low/max 实际生效。本页仅按实际请求参数分组，不称为已确认的有效档位比较。
display.methodEn: This batch calls k3.1-pro through Kimi Coding Plan’s native Anthropic Messages endpoint https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/messages. Each requested default/low/max configuration plans 23 tasks; at most three requests run concurrently, sequentially within each configuration. New dispatches stopped when the five-hour subscription quota was exhausted. Unsent tasks have no fabricated attempt, and quota failures are not scored as model-answer failures. Default is documented as max; omitted-default and explicit-max requests are independent records and are not treated as distinct capability levels. Low/max use native output_config.effort, not a thinking budget. Prompt-token totals sum native input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens; raw usage is retained. Initial max_tokens=12,288 covers thinking plus final output; timeout 600 seconds. Temperature/top_p omitted; no thinking.budget_tokens configured. Requests consume subscription quota; metered list prices are not the actual invoice. The stopped Chat Completions subset stays separate. Images and animation directly render the model’s unchanged SVG. Assessments are qualitative AI-assistant visual inspection. Single-request timings include queueing, concurrency and output-length effects; they do not establish a stable speed ranking. Requested and returned IDs are preserved; a mutable API route is not independent proof of a fixed internal checkpoint. The server accepted the invalid-effort negative control, so the effective low/max semantics are not independently confirmed. Results are grouped by requested parameters, not claimed as a verified effort-level comparison.
